---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability for the contract or its tooling
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What is currently missing or awkward? What are you trying to do that this
repository doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see added (a new fixture category, a validator flag, a
new document, etc.)? Note: if this is actually a change to the contract itself
(a new field, action, or invariant), please use the "Schema Change Proposal"
template instead — that has its own required checklist.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you didn't choose them.

## Scope check

Confirm this stays within this repository's scope (see `README.md`'s "What
this repository is NOT"): no runtime service, no business logic, no
authentication system, no eighth response action, no out-of-scope
infrastructure (queues, Kubernetes, etc.).
